NO MECHANISM_SPACE OPTIMIZATION is authorized on this evidence alone: the dominant cause is now MEASURED and FIXED (Cliff 1 classifier + Cliff 2 cemetery domain-identity), and an optimization requires a measured AVOIDABLE waste class, not merely a measured loss location.
